# Good Repo

## Problem Statement
Traditional hackathon judging is manual, slow, and subjective. This project automates repo evaluations.

## Setup
Run `npm install` and `npm test` to install dependencies and run the test suite.

## Demo
Watch the full walkthrough demonstration video showing scoring and criteria analysis.

## Team
Built by Alice, Bob, Charlie, and Dave.

## Code of Conduct
We follow the MLH Code of Conduct: https://github.com/MLH/mlh-policies/blob/main/code-of-conduct.md

Built with open-weight Gemma 4 judge model.
